author: Agness Abubakar Saidi
attribution: Photo: Agness Abubakar Saidi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Manyema_Road_street_sign_in_Moshi_Tanzania.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow street blade with black condensed capitals on a black-and-yellow pole, Moshi. The motorcyclist is incidental; a large cut-off billboard ('M...') at the top right and vehicle plates in the background are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Manyema Road street sign in Moshi Tanzania.jpg

author: SqueakyMarmot
attribution: Photo: SqueakyMarmot, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/37804160@N00/14517569948. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted red capitals on a white hanging board with a left arrow, Stone Town, Zanzibar, seen from below. Overhead cables cross the C of CHINESE and the E of RESTAURANT but the letters stay readable.

author: mattk1979
attribution: Photo: mattk1979, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/24879135@N04/2964153049. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Thin grey mounted capitals along the roof line of the old terminal, against a grey sky (low contrast); a mast crosses the T of INTERNATIONAL and the clock tower sits below. Distractors: the DTB (Diamond Trust Bank) cube under the clock and a green panel cut off at left ('...ar').

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/41000732@N04/8841982338. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted black capitals with a left arrow on a white pillar of a covered walkway at the Anglican cathedral (old slave market), Stone Town, Zanzibar. The sign is small in the lower left; the cathedral facade fills the rest of the frame. Same site as the cathedral welcome board but a different sign.
source_title: Facade of Cathedral with Sign for Slave Chambers - Anglican Cathedral-Old Slave Market - Stone Town - Zanzibar - Tanzania

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/41000732@N04/8830600858. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted signboard over a barbershop door in a colonial-era facade, Stone Town, Zanzibar. 'Saloon' (not Salon) is as written. Distractors: the small red 'BARBER SHOP' script at left, the older painted lintel text 'HAIR MIREY Cutting ... SALOON' around the date plaque '1931', and an 'OPEN' sign in the window.
source_title: Hair Salon Sign with Colonial-Era Facade - Stone Town - Zanzibar - Tanzania

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/41000732@N04/8841973088. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted heritage board outside the Anglican cathedral, Stone Town, Zanzibar. Only the black-on-white heading (the site name) is transcribed; the long white-on-green history text below and the 'FORMER SL... SITE ENTRANCE 4 USD ...' notice on the wall at right are distractors.
source_title: Sign outside Anglican Cathedral-Old Slave Market - Stone Town - Zanzibar - Tanzania

author: Fanny Schertzer
attribution: Photo: Fanny Schertzer, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Godwin_Loi_Shop.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White name board with a Coca-Cola bottle panel on the left, on the roof edge of a small shop on the Arusha-Dodoma road; seen from a distance. 'celtel' and 'Vodacom'-style operator posters on the wall are distractors; men seated on the veranda are incidental.

author: Mike from Vancouver, Canada
attribution: Photo: Mike from Vancouver, Canada, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bikini_Ice_Cream_Parlour_(14517787227).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted chalkboard-style easel sign with an ice-cream cone, beach bar on Zanzibar's north shore. The name line is the target; the price and slogan lines are advertising copy. A cocktail menu board behind ('BIK... HAPPY HOUR COCKTAIL') and a 'TIP BOX' are distractors.

author: Pb1791
attribution: Photo: Pb1791, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mikuni_National_Park_Danger-Sign_Bild_121.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/de/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Green board with a yellow border and stencil-style lettering on the highway through the park, seen at an angle from the left; red 'DANGER' on a white panel. The warning lines are secondary; the park name is the target.

author: knezovjb
attribution: Photo: knezovjb, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/14876615@N08/2823319504. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted sign over an alley entrance, Dar es Salaam. A bundle of cables hangs over the logo and the 'CO' of COMPUTER (still readable). The left edge of the frame trims the E of ENGLISH and the right edge may cut a final letter after COURSE. The fourth line has a phone icon before 2183740 and a P.O. Box (envelope) icon before 15732; DSM. = Dar es Salaam. The pink 'MDIA ELECTRONIC SERVICES' sign below (first letter missing) and the small repeat of the sign down the alley are distractors.

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/41000732@N04/8830451612. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large blue mounted capitals on the roof railing of a terminal building in the port area, Stone Town, Zanzibar. Two roof workers at left are incidental. Faint letters behind the lower window are not readable.
source_title: Zanzibar Sign - Port Area - Stone Town - Zanzibar - Tanzania

author: mattk1979
attribution: Photo: mattk1979, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/24879135@N04/2964096893. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted white script on a weathered wooden board, Paje, Zanzibar; a faded earlier painting of 'La Boutique' shows through. The C of Cristal and Clothing is a decorative capital. The separators in the third line are small dash-like marks, transcribed as hyphens. The 'KK SECURITY THE KK GROUP OF COMPANIES www.kksecurity.com' plate below is a distractor. Alternative query: 'La Boutique'.
source_title: La Boutique at Cristal Resort, Paje
